scripts.text:
[Keegan]
What brings you here? Have something to say?
scripts.translation:
[基根]
什么风把你吹来了？有什么事吗？

scripts.text: I want to be a Treasure Hunter
Take me to the Official Shop.

[Keegan]
Well {0} if you want to be a Treasure Hunter first you must.
 
^FF00001.^000000 You well be changed ^FF000025,000z^000000 for basic training and your proof of being a member.
 
Umm... Well that is all you need to do. Hahaha.
scripts.translation:
[基根]
好吧，{0}，如果你想成为宝物猎人，首先你必须。

^FF00001.^000000 你将支付 ^FF000025,000z^000000 作为基础训练费用以及成为成员的证明。

嗯……这就是你需要做的全部了。哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Keegan]
Welcome to the Guild of Treasure Hunters.
You may now take a Treasure Hunting Quest as you see fit.
scripts.translation:
[基根]
欢迎加入宝物猎人公会。
你现在可以随意接受宝物狩猎任务了。

scripts.text:
[Keegan]
Hmmm you don't seem to have ^FF000025,000z^000000 {0}. Please come back when you do.
scripts.translation:
[基根]
嗯，你似乎没有 ^FF000025,000z^000000，{0}。等你凑够了再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Keegan]
Well if you can't afford a small ^FF000025,000z^000000 you shouldn't be a Treasure Hunter yet.
scripts.translation:
[基根]
好吧，如果你连小小的 ^FF000025,000z^000000 都付不起，那你还不适合成为宝物猎人。

scripts.text:
[Keegan]
Ha ha ha...you are already a member.
scripts.translation:
[基根]
哈哈哈……你已经是成员了。

scripts.text:
[Keegan]
Well {0} if you wish to take a quest go talk to the fellow Treasure Hunter in the other room there.
scripts.translation:
[基根]
好吧，{0}，如果你想接任务，去和另一个房间里的宝物猎人同伴谈谈吧。

scripts.text:
[Keegan]
Sorry you must be a member of the Treasure Hunter Guild if you wish to take a quest.
 
Also now that you are a member feel free to use our shops anytime you wish.They are all located on this floor.
 
We also have another shop for members only,in which we use little metal diamonds called Treasure Hunter Tokens to exchange for rare goods.
 
You will even have access to our exclusive personal Dungeon.
scripts.translation:
[基根]
抱歉，如果你想接任务，必须是宝物猎人公会的成员。

另外，既然你已经是成员了，随时欢迎使用我们的商店。它们都位于这一层。

我们还有一个仅限成员进入的商店，在那里我们可以用称为“宝物猎人代币”的小金属钻石来交换稀有物品。

你甚至可以使用我们专属的个人地下城。

scripts.text:
[Keegan]
Yes {0} I will take you to our shop right away!
scripts.translation:
[基根]
是的，{0}，我马上带你去我们的商店！

scripts.text:
[Keegan]
I'm sorry only members may visit our private shop.
scripts.translation:
[基根]
抱歉，只有成员才能访问我们的私人商店。

scripts.text:
[Keegan]
Alright come back when you have the free time to spare.
scripts.translation:
[基根]
好吧，等你有空闲时间再回来吧。
